name: Positive Attitude
overview: Scripture reveals that a positive attitude is rooted in rejoicing in the day the Lord has made and trusting in His eternal Word, which stands forever despite life's fleeting troubles. Believers are called to seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, promising that their needs will be met, and to cast aside anxious thoughts about daily provisions. Abiding in Christ is essential, as true fruitfulness and gladness flow from a close relationship with Him, who anoints His followers with joy above others.
